# -health names the cause when NVML is lost, without a CUDA context.
[!exec:sh] skip
chmod 0755 bin/nvidia-smi
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH
! exec cudadoctor -health -json
stdout '"name": "gpu-health"'
stdout 'NVML failed through nvidia-smi \(exit 255\): Failed to initialize NVML: Unknown Error'

# -health alone checks only the device: no NVRTC lookup, workflow "health".
stdout '"workflow": "health"'
! stdout '"name": "nvrtc"'
! stdout '"name": "execution"'

# Naming a workflow adds its checks back.
env NVRTC_LIB_PATH=$WORK/missing/libnvrtc.so
! exec cudadoctor -health -workflow jit -json
stdout '"workflow": "jit"'
stdout '"name": "nvrtc"'
stdout '"name": "gpu-health"'

-- bin/nvidia-smi --
#!/bin/sh
echo 'Failed to initialize NVML: Unknown Error'
exit 255
